attribute.name: Port
attribute.description: Primary port at which clients' requests are accepted

attribute.name: Secondary Port
attribute.description: Secondary port is opened if primary port is busy

attribute.name: IP Address
attribute.description: Local IP address the server will bind to

attribute.name: Max Users
attribute.description: Maximum number of users simultaneously connected with http server

attribute.name: Request Timeout
attribute.description: Timeout in seconds. An inactive connection is closed after this timeout expiration.

attribute.name: Response Timeout
attribute.description: Time period in seconds necessary to write out 1KB data to the client. If the timeout expires before writing the data, connection is closed.

attribute.name: PersistentConnection
attribute.description: Specifies if persistent connections should be managed

attribute.name: On
attribute.description: Can be used to stop/start plain server

attribute.name: Name
attribute.description: Can be used to create different HttpService instances

attribute.name: Local Anonymous Connect
attribute.description: Allows anonymous connection through the HttpHelper service

attribute.name: Disable Templates Cache
attribute.description: Disables the local cache for the resources processed by the TemplatePlaceHolderReplace service
